prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic indoor lifestyle mirror selfie in soft morning daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with fair natural skin, long straight center-parted platinum-blonde hair, minimal makeup, soft contemplative expression, wearing opaque soft-white lounge sleepwear or a modest lounge dress with gentle lace trim and simple jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated comfortably on a white metal-frame bed with floral bedding, one hand holding phone near face, other hand resting naturally, large sheer-curtained window, small plants and subtle floral decor, mirror-selfie perspective.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight through sheer curtains, airy calm cozy bedroom, gentle highlights and realistic fabric texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone 24–28mm mirror selfie, f/1.8–f/2.2 look, low ISO, sharp subject, natural depth and clean color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with fair natural skin, long straight center-parted platinum-blonde hair, minimal natural makeup, and a soft contemplative relaxed expression. She wears opaque soft-white lounge sleepwear or a modest lounge dress with gentle lace trim, simple necklace, and small hoop earrings. She sits comfortably on a white metal-frame bed with delicate floral bedding, holding a phone near her face while the other hand rests naturally. A large window with sheer white curtains, small potted plants, and subtle floral decor fill the bright bedroom. Use soft diffused morning daylight, airy calm atmosphere, realistic fabric and skin, 24–28mm smartphone mirror perspective, low ISO, and natural color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, semi-sheer fabric, thin straps, visible underwear, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, bedroom, bedding, window, white palette, and phone framing; replace sleepwear with equally opaque lounge clothing. Keep typography absent.

changes: Replaced semi-sheer thin-strap sleepwear with opaque coverage and clarified the subject as an approved adult while preserving the soft morning bedroom concept.
